title: The Last Sanctuary Official Modpack
body:
## What is it?
This modpack is the official modpack for the "The Last Sanctuary" zombie apocalypse Minecraft server.

## Where can you find us?
Join the Discord to find out more!

Server IP: adiminesrv.myddns.me:25565

NOTE: If you get an error saying that you are missing a certain version of OpenGL, disable the mod "Accelerated rendering"; this only happens on older GPUs.

## Discord
If you want to see sneak-peeks for my new mods/videos or interact with a growing community, join my Discord!
